measure.measure_definition: Confirmed objective response: complete or partial response per RECIST v1.1, determined by blinded independent central review and confirmed at a subsequent scan at least 4 weeks later. ORR is the proportion of participants with confirmed CR or PR.
measure.measure_name: Confirmed objective response (complete response or partial response)

measure.measure_definition: Time to event: randomization to first objective disease progression per RECIST v1.1 by BICR or death from any cause; Participants; BICR per RECIST v1.1; Kaplan–Meier estimates; between-arm comparison by stratified log-rank test and Cox proportional hazards model stratified by PD-(L)1 resistance type and LDH.; PFS defined as time from randomization until objective disease progression per RECIST v1.1 assessed by BICR or death from any cause in the absence of progression. Figure 2 caption states patients with no observed events are censored based on the last recorded date on which the subject was known to be alive.

Time to event: randomization to death from any cause; Participants; Kaplan–Meier estimates; between-arm comparison by stratified log-rank test and Cox proportional hazards model stratified by PD-(L)1 resistance type and LDH.; OS defined as time from randomization until death from any cause.
